title: 菊花賞の後に・大団円

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki takes first in the Kikuka Sho. The audience is thrilled that she managed to overcome the limitations of her distance aptitude and conquer a long-distance race. Their expectations rise ever higher.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the race, she asks to participate in the Takamatsunomiya Kinen, a 1,200-meter G1 turf sprint.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm puzzled by her sudden change of heart, but I'm sure she has a reason.
